description: PROPOSED (Discussion #49, alternative B: declared aggregation), NOT in the spec on main. A declared strategy must be one of all, any, majority, weighted (the Aggregation Extension's four) plus the proposed strict and producer (INVALID_VALUE otherwise). `fail-closed` is the name examples/errored-graders used for the policy before this proposal gave it a strategy name (`strict`); an undefined name would leave a reader exactly as uninformed as no declaration. Also exercised by the reference validators but not this fixture: `weighted` without `threshold` (REQUIRED), `threshold` outside [0,1] (OUT_OF_RANGE), and a non-object declaration (TYPE_ERROR).
